I am a Computer Science undergraduate at IISER Bhopal (BS, 2023–2027).
I work on quantum information, in particular quantum convolutional codes and
entanglement distillation, and on numerical optimization software in Julia.

I am currently a research intern on quantum convolutional codes with
Dr. Filip Rozpedek and Dr. Stefan Krastanov at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, and I collaborate with
Prof. Dominique Orban at Polytechnique Montréal on [NCL.jl](https://github.com/JuliaSmoothOptimizers/NCL.jl)
and [Superb.jl](https://github.com/JuliaSmoothOptimizers/Superb.jl).
I am also a contributor to [Qiskit.jl](https://github.com/Qiskit/Qiskit.jl) and
[TagBot](https://github.com/JuliaRegistries/TagBot), and an LFX mentee in the Linux kernel.

## Interests

- Quantum error correction and entanglement distillation
- Quantum networks and repeater protocols
- Nonlinear constrained optimization
- Open-source scientific software

## Education

**IISER Bhopal**, BS in Computer Science, Aug 2023 – Aug 2027
